name: Franchise Architect: Football
currentFocus: Session 89 repaired the franchise economy, which had stopped functioning as a constraint. Measured on a seeded 20-season run, clubs over the  salary cap ran 0,0,1,2,10,27,30 and then 31 of 32 for every remaining season (median  over by season 20, worst ); the engine enforced the cap at exactly one seam while the draft added 224 unchecked rookie contracts a year, and no code path could release a player. There was also no roster limit at all, so the league grew 1,568 -> 2,919 players. New src/engine/capCompliance.js is the single release authority for both, wired into the headless and interactive offseason paths, with dead money split the real way so the trim loop converges. Re-measured: 0 illegal clubs after every offseason across 2027-2036, rosters pinned at 53+16. Also corrected the unreachable  declared salary ceiling (true maximum ,320,000) and shipped a negative-control-validated gate for the S88 empty-state husk class. Local proof 1,150/1,150 Node. Public launch remains HOLD and launchReady stays false.
nextMilestone: Calibrate league-wide talent inflation at the source — measured twice independently (league top-100 mean overall drifting 86.8 -> 94.2 across 20 seasons; realism regression 0.228 annual drift against a 0.15 ceiling). S89 bounded the symptom only. Also decide explicitly whether the long shard belongs in the canonical test receipt, since it currently carries a pre-existing failure that npm test never runs.
blockers: Pre-existing red outside the canonical receipt — test/realism-career-regression.test.js fails in the excluded long shard on 0.228 annual overall drift vs a 0.15 ceiling; verified to reproduce on pristine HEAD 8ddc310, queued as S90 calibration.

freeTierAuditNote: Session 75 refresh: browser-first game plus a bounded, cached community aggregate on the existing shared self-hosted server. No language model, email, paid analytics vendor, or per-user API spend; marginal cost remains zero within current fixed infrastructure capacity.
lastSessionSummary: Session 89 found and fixed a defect that had survived the project entire history: the salary cap stopped binding after about five simulated seasons, leaving 31 of 32 clubs illegal with the median club  over the cap, because the engine could gate additions but had no way to release a player and no roster limit at all. A new cap-compliance release authority fixes both, verified by re-measurement at the same seed (0 illegal clubs across 2027-2036). Also corrected an unreachable declared salary ceiling and shipped a validated gate for the S88 husk class. 1,150/1,150 Node. Launch remains HOLD.
